content: घटिका .²1 A small water-jar, bucket, a small earthen vessel; नार्यः श्मशानघटिका इव वर्जनीयाः <ls>Pt. 1. 192</ls>; एष क्रीडति कूपयन्त्रघटिकान्यायप्रसक्तो विधिः <ls>Mk. 10. 59</ls>. .²2 A measure of time equal to 24 minutes. .²3 A water-pot used in calculating the Ghaṭikās of the day; .²4 The ankle.
